title: Validation run result
description: One manual run of the fabricated validation cards against a model. Records the model, the date and a pass or fail per card, and nothing else: no prompts, outputs or transcripts.

model.description: The model evaluated, as its vendor names it.

run_date.description: The day the run finished, YYYY-MM-DD.

skills_version.description: The release tag or commit of this repository the run used.

runner.description: The person who judged the outputs.

results.description: One verdict per card, keyed by the card id from validation/cases/ without the .md suffix. A card appears at most once because a JSON object holds one value per key.
